app.title: Show HN: Petal, open-source CoScreen/ScreenHero finally free
app.author: thedracle
app.description: Petal is an open‑source screen‑recording and screen‑sharing tool similar to CoScreen/ScreenHero, providing a CLI for capturing and streaming desktop sessions.
proposed_tests: git clone petal repository and run ./install.sh
execute petal --help and verify usage output
start a short screen recording session and confirm output file creation
stream to a local RTMP server and measure latency
compare recording quality vs OBS Studio using same settings
